name: react-doctor
title_zh: 提交前先让 React 代码过一遍全科体检
tagline_zh: 改完 bug 或收尾功能时，它不只查 lint 和可访问性，还盯 bundle 体积和架构债，顺手跑回归。
tagline_en: After a fix or feature, it scans lint, a11y, bundle size, and architecture, then runs regressions and triages.
desc_en: Use when finishing a feature, fixing a bug, before committing React code, or when the user types `/doctor`, asks to scan, triage, or clean up React diagnostics. Covers lint, accessibility, bundle size, architecture. Includes a regression check and a full local-triage workflow that fetches the canonical playbook.
why_zh: 它把零散的 React 诊断串成一条完整流水线：从 lint 到架构，再到回归检查。
why_en: It chains scattered React diagnostics into one pipeline: lint to architecture, plus regression checks, then fetches the.
limit_zh: 只认 React 技术栈，非 React 项目会直接停；需要能联网拉取 playbook，离线环境只能做基础扫描。
limit_en: React-only; non-React repos stop it cold. Needs network to fetch the playbook—offline gets basic scans only. Outputs a triaged report with fixes.
title_en: A full React checkup before you commit
